name: brdcomp-dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal dialog with structured header, body, and footer regions. Sizes: xs, sm, md, lg, and fluid.

examples.title: Modal dialog
examples.code:
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog"

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger>Open</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Dialog title</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>Dialog description</DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
